events.title: Devlog #6: DEMO IS LIVE!
events.summary: What’s up, nerds? The big day is here! The Demo for ScareZone: Haunted Attraction Tycoon is now live. There are far too many people to thank right now and far too much to still polish before Next Fest - so I won't get into that now. But it's live! Go build something horrific, share it with us on Discord - and if anything goes wrong that Report a Bug button is waiting for ya.
